name: image-generation
description: Image generation skills for original editorial illustrations, photo-derived abstractions, visual metaphors, article art, diagrams, mini-comics, and print-style visual systems.

interface.shortDescription: 生成原创编辑插画、照片衍生抽象构成、视觉隐喻和手绘解释图。
interface.longDescription: Image Generation packages tmchow/illo-skill and ZzzLc0405/photo-abstract-editorial as Codex skills. It supports mascot-led editorial illustrations, article art, mini-comics, hand-built explainer diagrams, custom print looks, and faithful photo-plus-abstraction compositions derived from an uploaded photograph's observed spatial and color relationships.
defaultPrompt: Use illo to illustrate this article with one editorial image.
Use illo to create a mascot-led visual metaphor for this idea.
用 photo-abstract-editorial 把这张照片制作成摄影与抽象面板组合的编辑作品。
